freeze_rationale: The S703-S708 remediation wave eliminated DL-008, DL-016, and DL-025 across all 2,500 QIDs. The 700-series certification state is stable with 2,181 Certified items, 0 Editorial Queue items. DL-026 (13 Certified items) is a non-blocking pedagogical quality gap. This baseline freezes the certification state to prevent drift while the 100-series May and 500-series case-bank lanes proceed concurrently.

what_is_frozen.certification_state: All question_state values frozen as documented below. No state transitions permitted without a new 700-series session.
what_is_frozen.certification_blocking_defects: DL-008, DL-016, DL-025 are at zero and must not regress.
what_is_frozen.learner_pool: 2,181 Certified items constitute the learner delivery pool.
what_is_frozen.certification_governance: Governance guard Rule 2 (DL-008 BLOCK), Rule 3 (registry generation), Rule 5 (30-item batch cap) remain active.

what_is_not_frozen.dl026_remediation: Optional — can proceed in S710 if user authorizes.
what_is_not_frozen.dl031_dl032_difficulty: Optional — can proceed in S711 if user authorizes.
what_is_not_frozen.non_certified_dl026: Optional — can proceed in S712 if user authorizes.

dl026_treatment.classification: Minor pedagogical quality gap — not a certification blocker
dl026_treatment.description: Each affected Certified item has exactly one empty distractor ExplanationWrong slot. Learners selecting that specific distractor see no educational feedback. All items are DL-008 clean (empty ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice]). Correct answers, stems, and choices are unaffected.
dl026_treatment.remediation: Optional. If authorized, S710 would add choice-specific distractor explanations without changing answer keys, stems, choices, or certification states.
dl026_treatment.certification_impact: None — all 13 items remain Certified. The empty distractor slot is a quality-of-feedback gap, not an accuracy defect.

s710_certified_dl026.risk: Low — no answer key, stem, choice, or state changes

s711_difficulty_recalibration.risk: Medium — metadata-only, no content changes, but scope is ~500 items

s712_non_certified_dl026.scope: 299 non-Certified DL-026 items in Unprocessed/Archived pools
s712_non_certified_dl026.risk: Low — outside learner pool, no urgency
